mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increase does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decrease does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decrease does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a supply-demand imbalance, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of GDPC1 increase and INDPRO decrease does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
